findings.bill_quote: A large frontier developer shall transmit to the Office of Emergency Services a summary of any assessment of catastrophic risk resulting from internal use of its frontier models
findings.problem: The box summary of duties leaves out the quarterly internal-use risk summaries that large frontier developers must send to the Office of Emergency Services. It also leaves out the 24-hour imminent-risk disclosure. 'Among other duties' signals that the list is incomplete but does not tell readers about these notable duties.

findings.bill_quote: Notwithstanding Section 916 of the Code of Civil Procedure, injunctive relief granted pursuant to this section shall not be stayed pending appeal.
findings.problem: The entry leaves out the whistleblower enforcement provisions that injunctive relief is not stayed pending appeal and that remedies are cumulative (§1107.1(i), (j)).

findings.bill_quote: Before, or concurrently with, deploying a new frontier model or a substantially modified version of an existing frontier model, a frontier developer shall clearly and conspicuously publish on its website a transparency report
findings.problem: The box lists the framework, audit, incident-reporting and whistleblower duties and covers the rest with 'among other duties'. It leaves out the transparency report that every frontier developer must publish at deployment. It also leaves out the large-developer disclosure statement and fee that begin in 2027, so the summary hides core duties.

findings.bill_quote: (B) the failure by a frontier developer to meet the standards of, or comply with the requirements stated by, the federal law, regulation, or guidance document designated pursuant to subsection (a) shall constitute a violation of this Act.
findings.problem: The box says the Section 25 penalty 'applies to large frontier developers only', which is accurate. It does not mention that the duties on smaller frontier developers have no penalty attached in the Act. A reader could assume those duties are enforced in the same way.

findings.bill_quote: provided, however, that failure by a frontier developer to meet the standards of, or comply with the requirements stated by, the federal law, regulation or guidance document designated pursuant to subsection (h) shall constitute a violation of this chapter.
findings.problem: The entry covers only the declaration step of the federal-equivalence safe harbor in Section 3(i)(1). It leaves out the deemed-compliance effect, the rule that failing the designated federal standard is itself a violation, and the attorney general's duty to designate (3(h)) and revoke (3(j)) such federal laws by regulation.

findings.bill_quote: (1) The third party shall be granted access to all materials reasonably necessary to comply with the third party’s obligations under this section, including, but not limited to, all unredacted versions of materials published pursuant to this chapter.
findings.problem: The entry omits the third party's right of access to unredacted materials and, for evaluators, to the most capable frontier models and reasonable answers to their questions (3A(b)(3)). It also omits the 3A(a)(3) duty to retain the unredacted audit report for the deployment period plus 5 years.

subsection (2) may be brought in the circuit court for the county where the
alleged violation occurred
findings.problem: The entry leaves out the venue provision for employee civil actions in Sec. 11(4).

findings.bill_quote:
(8) This section does not
diminish or impair the rights of a person under any collective bargaining
findings.problem: The o2 quote is not character-for-character accurate: the line break in the bill falls after "does not", but the entry breaks after "does".

findings.bill_quote: (j) assessing and managing catastrophic risk resulting from the internal use of its frontier models, including risks resulting from a frontier model circumventing oversight mechanisms.
findings.problem: The entry never lists the ten required contents of the framework (items (a)-(j)), such as third-party assessment, cybersecurity of model weights and internal-use risk. It only says "all of the listed matters" without naming them.

findings.bill_quote: (a) When a frontier developer publishes documents to comply with this section, such frontier developer may make redactions to such documents that are necessary to protect such frontier developer's trade secrets
findings.problem: The redaction permission in § 1421(5)(a) and the model-card deemed-compliance rule in § 1421(3)(c) are both left out; the entry covers only the duty to describe redactions.
